# GeoSRM - Satellite Super-Resolution

> AI-powered deep learning super-resolution mapping for medium-resolution satellite imagery (Sentinel-2 EuroSAT). Built by Team 404 Brain Not Found for Smart India Hackathon 2026.

## Overview
GeoSRM is a geospatial application that enhances medium-resolution satellite images (e.g. 10m/pixel Sentinel-2 imagery) using an SRCNN (Super-Resolution Convolutional Neural Network) PyTorch model with GPU acceleration.

## Features
- **4x Spatial Resolution Enhancement**: Enhances fine surface features, building outlines, roads, and agricultural field boundaries.
- **TIFF & PNG Export**: Preserves raster formats for downstream GIS workflows in QGIS and ArcGIS.
- **Side-by-Side Comparison**: Interactive split slider for before/after visual verification.
- **Local PyTorch API**: Zero-dependency multithreaded REST server with CUDA RTX acceleration and CPU fallback.
